profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Gentle and close to its people, the Braque Français often brings a cooperative, readily trained character to its pointing work. Both the Gascony and Pyrenean types share a keen nose and versatility across open ground, woods and mountains. The smaller Pyrenean type tends to hunt faster, while the larger Gascony type often mixes trotting with galloping.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Gentle and cooperative, the Braque Français brings a keen nose and versatile pointing skills to varied hunting terrain.
